title: Stop Giving Senior CSMs Work They Cannot Decide
excerpt: Use decision authority, customer consequence, and enduring value to decide what a senior CSM should own, prepare, coordinate, or stop doing.
primary_goal: Help CS leaders reassign recurring work that consumes senior CSM capacity without giving the CSM the authority to decide or improve it.
primary_cta: Run the Work Ownership Decision Matrix on one recurring task.
playbook_description: A work inventory, authority test, ownership decision, and handoff record for deciding what CS should own, prepare, coordinate, or remove.

subject_variants.label: problem
subject_variants.subject: Your senior CSM is not the default owner
subject_variants.preheader: Use decision authority and customer consequence to decide what CS should own, coordinate or stop doing.
